_about: Seasonal collections, shown as a chip on the shelf while today (Vancouver) is between start and end, inclusive. Dates are "MM-DD" (every year) or "YYYY-MM-DD" (that year only). A listing belongs when any rule matches: genres (TMDB genre names), title_keywords (whole words or phrases in the listed or TMDB title, ignoring case and accents), late_from_hour (starts at that hour or later, or before 4 AM), tmdb_ids. accent replaces the page's amber while the collection is ticked. Validated by the tests; see kinolocator/seasonal.py.

collections.name: Halloween
collections.note: Horror, late shows from 10 PM, and live-score events.

collections.name: Holidays
collections.note: Christmas and winter-holiday films, by title words and a list of perennials (It's a Wonderful Life, Die Hard, Home Alone, Elf, A Christmas Story, Love Actually, Gremlins, The Muppet Christmas Carol).
